title: Plan for Moderate Income Housing — Section 3.18 of the Town of Alta General Plan
repository: Town of Alta (townofalta.utah.gov / Juniper GCS media library tenant 130)
notes: Alta's MIH element is a LEGACY EMBEDDED SECTION (Section 3.18, printed p.13) of the General Plan, NOT a standalone HB462-era element. It cites the pre-2019 statute 'Title 10, Chapter 9, Part 307' (superseded by 10-9a-403/408) and frames Alta's MIH obligation as EMPLOYEE HOUSING: the 1989 zoning ordinance requires employee living accommodations for new Base-Facilities-zone commercial development + caretaker units, with a current employee-housing inventory kept at the Town Office. Same raw PDF as the general_plan row (do NOT double-count as two files). No modern (HB462) standalone MIH element or annual 10-9a-408 report is published — see AVAILABILITY.md.
